failedIterationsAndCorrections.observedProblemAndCorrection: Android unit-test compilation rejected java.lang.management/com.sun.management on the Android API classpath. Moved host-only allocation instrumentation to a Kotlin JVM test module compiling the exact production sources.

Single first-use JVM allocation probe reported 744 bytes. Warmed the MXBean probe and identical batch method, then required zero bytes in ALL three measured 2000-frame windows. This does not make first-use initialization or ART allocation-free.

Quantitative NS fixtures found only 2.47 dB stationary-noise reduction and 3.01 dB after a floor increase. Fixed downward PSD update bias and used Wiener amplitude gain rather than its square root. Kept the acceptance thresholds unchanged and added startup/live-toggle cases.

evidenceMethod: Observed gh run view / GitHub check-run annotations. Production/test hashes are local git blobs at the validated commit. CI APK/report artifacts not independently downloaded or rehashed.
limits: No local JDK/Android SDK or Windows/WDK. Target builds/tests ran on GitHub-hosted JDK 17 + Android SDK / Windows runners.
No Z Flip6 AudioRecord execution, real speech-corpus listening/intelligibility evaluation, ART-wide allocation/GC, thermal/battery or physical 600s soak.
10ms is nominal WOLA alignment, not measured CPU or E2E delay. 30-50ms E2E goal remains unverified.
Zero allocated bytes refers to all three warmed HotSpot DSP/configure batches only, not construction, cold calls, ART/framework, capture or networking.
Stationary-noise suppressor is not a gate, speech classifier, other-speaker remover, AEC, AGC or de-reverberation implementation. Tonal and nonstationary noise may remain.
De-reverb is a separate feature design only; online WPE is an unimplemented research candidate, with no achieved performance/quality claims.
Unsigned WDK and diagnostic EXE regression success does not resolve Microsoft signing, elevated installation, real driver/audio routing or consumer-app acceptance.
